summaryZh: Hampton 研究组研究细胞选择性降解蛋白质的调控，重点包括 HMGCoA 还原酶（HMGR）与内质网蛋白降解，并以酿酒酵母为模型。既有官方介绍还涉及胆固醇合成调节、错误折叠蛋白处理、脂质信号和细胞器动态。
researchQuestions: 细胞如何选择性降解蛋白质？
topics: 选择性蛋白降解与 HMGR 调控
内质网蛋白降解与错误折叠蛋白处理
胆固醇合成、脂质信号与细胞器动态
methods: 酿酒酵母（出芽酵母）模型

evidence.quote: Our group studies a variety of questions that surround how the cell selectively destroys proteins.
These studies are ongoing and have led us in a number of interesting directions including cellular management of misfolded proteins, lipid signaling, and the dynamics of the ER and other organelles.
Biology department at the University of California, San Diego
